Version Added

Date Added

April 14th, 2024

Flowers are a randomly spawned Loose item that spawn on the ground or bushes, there are rare variants of the flowers which have a chance of spawning.

When placed in a Press Machine along with an empty jar, flowers will be turned into their corresponding dye. Dyes can be applied to certain items by using a Dye Machine, or sold for 4x the base price of their respective flower.
